entities.summary: Jarrett Lee Bush is an American former professional football player who was a cornerback in the National Football League (NFL). He was originally signed by the Carolina Panthers as an undrafted free agent in 2006, but was claimed by the Green Bay Packers as a waiver-wire pickup following the 2006 preseason and has played through the 2014 regular season. With Green Bay, Bush won Super Bowl XLV over the Pittsburgh Steelers. Bush also played for the Calgary Stampeders of the Canadian Football League (CFL). He played college football at Utah State and American River College.
